effects.display_name: Thicket melee / Verdant arrow Poison payload
effects.actual_behavior: Thicket calls super.doHurtTarget first, then on success with empty main hand and a LivingEntity target applies vanilla POISON through LivingEntity.addEffect with itself as source. Verdant calls super.getArrow and adds a POISON MobEffectInstance only when the returned projectile is an Arrow. These are separate application paths.

Verdant: genuine native bow/Arrow, admitted arrow hurt, LivingEntity, excludes successful Enderman early-return path; post-hurt addEffect then loader MobEffectEvent.Applicable. DEFAULT calls canBeAffected; APPLY/DENY can alter admission.

components.formula: If health >1, request 1 damage; interval=max cadence(25 >> amplifier), every tick when shift result <=0.

Assignment replaces the timer; it does not add 240. This is not a registered freezing MobEffect.

effects.display_name: Zombie / Murk / Verdant freeze eligibility overrides
effects.actual_behavior: Murk and Verdant explicitly return false from canFreeze. A LivingEntity WrapMethod shim is overridden through the Zombie mixin superclass chain; ZombieMixin's implementation returns false. The latter is a Zombie-wide native modification, not just a Gelid override. The entity type builder also marks Gelid immune to powder snow blocks. Static mixin declarations and plugin eligibility are pinned; transformed runtime behavior is not tested here.

effects.actual_behavior: ZombieMixin tracks powder-snow time on server while alive and with AI enabled. At 140 exposure ticks it starts a 300-tick conversion countdown; subsequent in-powder-snow ticks decrement it and a negative countdown converts to the Gelid entity type, passing true to convertTo. Leaving powder snow resets exposure to -1 and cancels the converting flag. This replaces the attack-capable entity with the variant providing the freeze/snowball paths above; it is not merely an animation. Native convertTo creates a fresh entity, copies position/baby/NoAI/name/persistence/invulnerable and optionally loot/equipment/drop chances, transfers mount, then discards old entity. It does not copy HP, active effects or arbitrary persistent state. It does not call finalizeSpawn, so conversion does not itself grant Gelid the default offhand snowball. Existing main-hand equipment can prevent Gelid unarmed freeze delivery.
